test_input: Press SPACE repeatedly to keep the bird aloft and navigate through pipes. If the bird hits a pipe or the top/bottom edge, the game ends and prints GAME OVER. After game over press R to restart. Press ESCAPE to quit.
expected_win_output: No separate win condition in this game. Expected console output when playing until a loss includes repeated lines 'FLAP' for each Space press, 'SCORE:<n>' each time a pipe is passed, and finally 'GAME OVER' when the bird dies. After pressing R you should see 'RESTART'. After pressing ESCAPE you should see 'QUIT'.
expected_lose_output:
'FLAP' (printed each time Space is pressed)
'SCORE:<n>' (printed when the bird successfully passes a pipe; n increases by 1)
'GAME OVER' (printed once when the bird collides or goes out of bounds)
'RESTART' (printed when R is pressed to restart)
'QUIT' (printed when ESCAPE is pressed or window is closed)
notes:
Controls and exact printed lines:
- Space (KEYDOWN): makes the bird flap upward and prints 'FLAP' to the console (flush=True).
- R (KEYDOWN): restarts the game and prints 'RESTART'. This resets score to 0, bird to starting position, and clears pipes.
- Escape (KEYDOWN) or window close: prints 'QUIT' and exits the game.
- Each time the bird passes a pipe without collision, the game prints 'SCORE:<n>' where <n> is the new score.
- When the bird collides with a pipe or touches the top/bottom of the screen the game prints 'GAME OVER' once and stops all motion onscreen.

Implementation files and coverage:
- game/flappy_bird_clone.py: implements all game logic (input, physics, pipes, scoring, collision, rendering, restart and quit). It owns all state: bird (bird_x, bird_y, bird_vy), pipes list, score, timers and game_over flag.
- game/__init__.py: package marker.

Known limitations and notes:
- Pipe sprite images are scaled vertically to fill variable pipe heights; this may stretch the supplied pipe_segment.png.
- If the provided asset files are missing, procedural fallbacks draw simple shapes for the bird and pipes, but the supplied assets are present in the Plan and will be used by the harness.
- There is no separate WIN condition; only GAME OVER (loss) is implemented as required by the Plan.
- The game runs at 60 FPS (clock.tick) and uses pixel coordinates with (0,0) at the top-left. The bird's horizontal position is fixed at x=100.

Play tips for testers:
- Press Space repeatedly to keep altitude; scoring occurs when the bird's x passes a pipe's right edge.
- After GAME OVER, press R to restart; verify score resets and pipes disappear.

This manual corresponds to the implemented behaviour in game/flappy_bird_clone.py and is intended for the harness smoke/play checks.
